content.name: p
children: Before typing any YAML, here is the role graph the manifest below describes — a single login role with read-only access to one schema.

content.name: p
children: , and membership still feel like separate pieces, start with
, then return here to apply the model.

content.name: Fence
children:
roles:
  - name: analytics
    login: true
    comment: "Analytics read-only role"

grants:
  - role: analytics
    privileges: [CONNECT]
    object: { type: database, name: mydb }
  - role: analytics
    privileges: [USAGE]
    object: { type: schema, name: public }
  - role: analytics
    privileges: [SELECT]
    object: { type: table, schema: public, name: "*" }
